item.title: Suspecting court of using AI, man injected prompts in filings to try to win case
item.description:
📝 Screenshot of hidden text in court filing. ” Elliott told Reuters yesterday that he maintains that his intent was to audit the court, but Spader did not find that argument credible. Regarding the prompts that Elliott claimed were meant in jest, Spader said “it defies logic” for Elliott to include hidden jokes in pleadings that he wants the court to take seriously.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/08/suspecting-court-of-using-ai-man-injected-prompts-in-filings-to-try-to-win-case/
